edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/mm/mlock.c
+++ /linux/mm/mlock.c
@@ -735,0 +736,9 @@
+		/*
+		 * If we have valid prev, it should be strictly before the current
+		 * vma. If not, then we probably entered a new vma from the
+		 * previous iteration, or something else is inconsistent; just
+		 * ignore prev to avoid sanity check failures in vma_merge.
+		 */
+		if (prev && vma->vm_start <= prev->vm_start)
+			prev = NULL;
+
